methods.name: Extended two-way fixed effects (Wooldridge) with emfx aggregations
methods.reference: etwfe::etwfe(fml, tvar, gvar, ivar = unit, cgroup = 'notyet' | 'never', tref, gref, vcov = ~unit | 'iid') via fixest::feols; etwfe::emfx(type = 'simple' | 'event' | 'group' | 'calendar'); exact delta method written out in validation/r/cases/causal_etwfe.R; anticipation as etwfe on first_treat - anticipation
quantities: cohort x period coefficients (notyet, never, tref, anticipation)
cell t p-values (G - 1 and n - k - rank(FE) df)
emfx simple, event, group and calendar estimates
delta-method SEs, z p-values, 95% and 90% CIs
all-treated panels (default and user gref, cgroup never with gref)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 600-960: coefficients and aggregates 1e-8, SEs, p-values and CIs 1e-6 relative; counts and keys exact; marginaleffects' numerical-Jacobian SEs cross-checked at 1e-6 relative; collinear control terms (test_etwfe_collinear_controls_are_reported) and non-identified cells refused (test_etwfe_unidentified_cells_are_an_error) are covered by unregistered property tests, not pinned here

deviations.note: default vcov is clustered by unit (CR1, fixest's small-sample factor); fixest 0.14 / etwfe 0.6.2 default to iid; vcov = Iid reproduces it (the cases request both explicitly)
